title: PART 4 / CHEW ON THIS
goal: Use story evidence and shared experiences to explore different perspectives, respond to conflict, and strengthen teamwork.
outcomes: Compare perspectives and responses to conflict.
Identify qualities of a strong teammate.
focus: Encourage students to consider different perspectives and support their thinking with evidence.
assessment: Team Talk: Listen for ideas supported by the story. Conflict Scenarios: Look for respectful responses that consider more than one perspective.

rows.description: Select up to three prompts and display them.

rows.text: Students discuss in pairs or small groups, using story evidence to support their ideas.
Slides 2–6 — Assign one of the four scenarios to each group.
Groups consider different perspectives, agree on a respectful response, and share briefly.
What would an assertive response sound like?
Slide 7 — Revisit Maddie’s changing perspective on Leila.
Optional role-play extension: rehearse and perform a selected scenario, then compare responses. Add 15–25 minutes.
Share one takeaway about friendship or teamwork to carry into Part 5.

bonuses.description: Bulletin Board — 5–10 min. Show Slide 8. Complete “A strong teammate is someone who…” and display responses. Print large slips (two per page).
— Small slips (four per page). Print one size only.

source_note: Approved user feedback 2026-11-04: no Zenix Case Check; Team Talk opens lesson, role-play extends Conflict Scenarios, Bulletin Board is optional. Slides are lesson-local 1–8.
